rawContent: Still processing how this #chaz improves race relations. Seems like they hijacked #BlackLivesMatter for their own cause. I don't like the graffiti. I did hear they're peaceful, self-policing. However, what is the group's purpose?
Karen lives around us, works with us, shops where we shop. That's why we must #StandForEquality #Inclusion #Diversity 🙏 #BlackLivesMatter #TimeForChange

Thank you @SeattlePD for the #peaceful transition. I've walked by #eastprecinct thousands of times; every single @TIME thought, "Police here make me feel so safe exercising my #Constitutional #freedoms." Welcome back! Know that you are loved. I know you believe #BlackLivesMatter!

@SeattlePD 🌹💖🙏💞 Thank you for your #service #empathy #humility. You are more loved than you think. People forget you are #peaceful human beings from families who share the alarm of #BlackLivesMatter #StandForEquality #inclusion #Diversity 🇺🇸 @NAACP #CHOP #CHAZ

@tslauson @Q13FOX Sigh. Breathtaking, swift, peaceful. Thank you @SeattlePD @BvuePD. @FBI @FBISeattle 🙏 I'm all for celebrating life, peaceful expression, partying like it's the playa BUT @lawandorder essential to civilized society. Onward #BlackLivesMatter 💖🙏🌹#TimeForChange

Seattle Police Dismantle ‘Police Free’ Zone Thank you @SeattlePD! #Anarchy not #BlackLivesMatter. #Violence not part of #StandForEquality #Inclusion #Diversity. #Peaceful #change the only way to mountaintop. 🙏 Clean up the area, bring back the... https://t.co/yHQqaGEuu0
@SDOTtraffic Hope everyone stays safe, incl @SeattlePD 🙏 We can all support #freedom of expression and #Nonviolence 🎋#TimeForChange #BlackLivesMatter
Majority seem peaceful. But only takes a handful of instigators to cause damage. Who goes to a peaceful protest armed w a baseball bat? Likely no ties to #BLM
@jasonrantz Scary. Hope the group doesn't incl the vandals, who likely are not even connected to civil rights movement. I mean, why destroy your own community that supports #BlackLivesMatter?

Unbelievable. The violence is a distraction and doesn't have anything to do w #BlackLivesMatter. Who are these people and what is their cause? Attacking another human being-- police or anyone-- and damaging property usually against the law.... unless you're in Seattle?
@jasonrantz Does he realize the protest is about #BlackLivesMatter? His rage is obviously unrelated to racial justice. I notice from the  videos that a lot of instigators are white.

It's time #BlackLivesMatter denounce the violence, period. Violence has no place in #CivilRights protests. It's about #PEACEFULResistance. When I march for #Equality, I pack water, juice, snacks, sunblock/chapstick, extra socks/tshirt, NOT explosives, a crowbar or baseball bat.

@SeattlePD #BlackLivesMatter silence on #AntifaTerrorists #anarchy violence convenient. For now. Once society shattered, antifa/anarchists will seek to destroy BLM #PeopleOfColor. That is reality. BLM must condemn, separate itself, return to MLKJr's peaceful approach to change @dorimonson
